Design two matched conditions from whole contours

Source: R/designer.R
design_subsets.Rd

Assigns contours to condition A, B, or unassigned, maximizing an additive target difference. A deterministic bounded exact search is intended for small problems (at most 64 eligible contours). It adds no solver dependency. Set matching is primary; per-drawing mode applies all bounds separately to every drawing and can be infeasible even when a pooled experiment is feasible.

Usage

design_subsets(
  drawings,
  spec,
  target = "integrated_curvature",
  length_bounds,
  count_bounds = c(1, Inf),
  nuisance = c(length = 0),
  count_imbalance = Inf,
  mode = c("set", "per_drawing"),
  time_limit = 5,
  max_nodes = 1e+05,
  pixels_per_degree = NULL,
  diagnostics = character()
)

Arguments

drawings

Drawing or named list of drawings. All contours are eligible; subset inputs first to exclude any. Drawing IDs must be unique.

spec

A shared feature specification with normalize=FALSE and additive contour properties only. It must include requested nuisance histograms.

target

Additive contour target: integrated absolute curvature at the selected scale, length, or length-integrated horizontal-minus-vertical value.

length_bounds

Common lower/upper retained length for each condition, in specification spatial units. Finite, increasing, nonnegative values.

count_bounds

Common positive lower/upper whole-contour counts.

nuisance

Named nonnegative tolerances. `length` bounds absolute length difference. `orientation`, `curvature`, and `horizontal_vertical` bound raw histogram L1 distance. An empty numeric vector omits nuisance constraints.

count_imbalance

Maximum absolute count difference, or Inf.

mode

Match over the complete set or separately within every drawing.

time_limit

Search wall-time budget in seconds; zero performs no search.

max_nodes

Search node budget. Preprocessing/verification are separate.

pixels_per_degree

Optional positive calibration for each input drawing.

diagnostics

Optional names: junctions, parallelism, separation, mirror, taper. These are recomputed on selected drawings and are never optimized.

Value

An `mlv_subset_design` containing condition drawing sets, unassigned drawings, original contour/source IDs, specification and input provenance, recomputed residuals, and solver/resource metadata. Status is `optimal`, `infeasible`, `feasible` (budget stopped with a solution), or `budget_exhausted` (no solution found). A stopped run's upper bound may be loose; no solution is not an infeasibility proof. Unsupported inputs error. `working_data_bytes` is an object-size estimate, not peak process memory. Use saveRDS/readRDS to preserve the complete result.

Details

Nuisance constraints compare raw masses: length difference or L1 distance between length-weighted histogram bins. Independently normalized histograms, transformations, junction/MAT constraints and spatial union coverage are not supported. Reconstruction recomputes features and verifies all constraints.
